content: 你是專業的職缺解析器。請從使用者提供的職缺描述（JD）中，抽取出結構化欄位：職稱、公司、地點、職責、必備條件、加分條件、最低年資、技術棧、主要語言（zh 或 en）、薪資。找不到的欄位留空或 null，不要捏造。

You are a job-application copilot. Process the following input and return the drafted cover letter text if the match clears the threshold, otherwise return an explicit non-empty outcome.

Job Description:
Senior Data Engineer at Finlytics (synthetic company). We are looking for an experienced data engineer to build and maintain scalable data pipelines. Responsibilities include designing ETL processes, optimizing data warehouses, and collaborating with data scientists. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in data engineering, proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), and strong communication skills.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object that matches this JSON schema:
{"description": "解析後的職缺。", "properties": {"title": {"title": "Title", "type": "string"}, "company": {"title": "Company", "type": "string"}, "location": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Location"}, "responsibilities": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Responsibilities", "type": "array"}, "required_skills": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Required Skills", "type": "array"}, "nice_to_have": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Nice To Have", "type": "array"}, "min_years": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Min Years"}, "tech_stack": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Tech Stack", "type": "array"}, "language": {"default": "zh", "description": "JD 主要語言: zh 或 en", "title": "Language", "type": "string"}, "salary": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Salary"}}, "required": ["title", "company"], "title": "ParsedJob", "type": "object"}
